title: Name the failing run and its ci logs command when ci wait fails
body:
Outcome: a failed krn ci wait (exit 74) names the failing run id and the exact bin/krn ci logs --run <id> command, so the lead reads the failure in one step instead of looking up the run.
Evidence: t-9s89hgs shipped bin/krn ci logs; the wait failure message still says only gh run rerun <run-id> --failed, leaving the run id lookup to the lead.
Acceptance: test/ci/wait.test.ts asserts the exit-74 message contains the run id from the check run details and the ci logs command; captured check-run JSON drives it.
